judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is functionally identical to the reference, accurately accumulating usage across tool rounds while ignoring missing round usages and returning undefined when no round reports usage. It satisfies all acceptance criteria, actually interpreting the requirement that 'the type of what the hook receives makes the answer unambiguous' more literally than the reference by introducing a backward-compatible `TurnUsageTotal = UsageMetadata` type alias (whereas the reference merely renamed the parameter to `totalUsage`). Minor divergences from the reference include placing the `sumUsage` helper in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` rather than private to `chatOrchestrator.ts`, creating a new acceptance test file instead of appending to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and placing the new spec assertions under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` instead of moving it to the main spec section.
